LanguageData.WBM_BankVaultInspect: This vault only accepts colony currency and is used by colonists to collect their wages.
LanguageData.WBM_NoPaidWorkYet: No paid work logged yet this pay period.
LanguageData.WBM_PaydayMessage: Payday has arrived. Colonists with positive net pay will head to a Bank Vault to collect their currency. They will also judge their clothing, food, weapons, and comforts against their wealth.
LanguageData.WBM_Settings_CurrencyDescription: Set colony currency to {0}. The base silver item is renamed and its appearance changes to match.
LanguageData.WBM_Settings_WorkRatesHeader: Currency per in game hour by work type
LanguageData.WBM_Settings_WorkRatesDescription: Set decimal currency per in game hour for every work type. Only active working time is counted, not walking, breaks, or idle time.
LanguageData.WBM_Settings_ItemCostsDescription: These are true values before Community Assistance. Poor pawns pay less, rich pawns pay more, shared household wealth affects the discount, and pawns can go into debt if they cannot afford a consumable.
LanguageData.WBM_BankVaultBankerActive: Banker status: on site for about {0} more in game hour(s)
LanguageData.WBM_BankVaultBankerCooldown: Banker status: available again in about {0} in game hour(s)
LanguageData.WBM_RequestBankerDescription: Send for a banker who visits like a trader, stays near the Bank Vault for about 12 in game hours, buys nearly anything, and arrives with a heavily armored expert marksman guard who stays friendly unless the banker or guard is attacked.
LanguageData.WBM_BankerUnavailableNoMap: No active map was found for this bank.
LanguageData.WBM_BankerUnavailableNoBank: You need at least one Bank Vault before you can request a banker.
LanguageData.WBM_BankerUnavailableActive: A banker is already visiting this settlement.
LanguageData.WBM_BankerUnavailableCooldown: The banker is on cooldown for about {0} more in game hour(s).
LanguageData.WBM_BankerRequested: The banker is on the way and will visit your Bank Vault for about 12 in game hours with a heavily armored guard at his side.
LanguageData.WBM_BankerSpawnFailed: Could not spawn the banker. Check that your map has a reachable edge and a valid Bank Vault.
LanguageData.WBM_BankerDeparted: The banker and his guard have wrapped up business and left the settlement.
LanguageData.WBM_OnlyOneBankVault: Only one Bank Vault can be placed on a map at a time.
